messages:
Jo Park: Dropping a tiny dark-mode tweak for the Overview charts. Problems: legend chips look cramped on 320px, inline `code` in the details pane doesn't contrast, and the orange series gets lost in screenshots. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/example

Luis Vega: Quick: bump legend to 13px semibold or raise contrast. Orange (#ff8a3d) -> too close to red; suggest #ffb56f.

Samira Khan: For inline code, suggest bg rgba(255,255,255,0.03) + 1px inner stroke rgba(255,255,255,0.04). Token palette idea: keyword #8deaff, fn #bfe8b0, string #ffd99e. Block code gets 8px padding.

Design-Bot: Component note added to Figma: stacked legend for mobile, pattern variants for lines, and token names.

ContrastBot: Auto-audit: legend-text vs bg -> 6.9:1 (PASS). orange old #ff8a3d vs bg -> 2.9:1 (FAIL). proposed #ffb56f -> 5.2:1 (PASS). focus ring missing on legend toggles (FAIL). Recommend 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.18).

Jo Park: Thanks. I'll update tokens and add focused aria-label copy: "Toggle visibility for <series>". Planning a micro PR and QA run. Closing after merge.
